version.value: Michael Laucke’s arrangement for solo guitar
version.note: The performer’s description says the arrangement retains the piano original’s notes within six strings. This is the arranger’s statement, not an editorial note-by-note certification. Pitch-class comparison with the D-major piano recording supports a transposition to A; exact guitar voicings and octaves have not been score-aligned.

performers.note: The file title names the performer; the summary credits his Commons account Mlaucke and describes his arrangement.

date.note: Commons gives 23 July 2001 as the work/file date, but does not explicitly identify it as the session date. The listening page preserves it only as a source date; the 19 November 2015 upload is not a recording date.

place.note: The file page does not identify a recording venue.

label.note: The file is described as the uploader’s own work; no source release or carrier label is established.

catalogue.note: No carrier catalogue number is supplied.

credits.note: Upload credit does not establish a recording or mastering engineer.

date.note: No transfer or mastering date is supplied. Commons records upload on 19 November 2015 and its MP3 transcode on 25 February 2026.

processing.value: FLAC source; Wikimedia Commons MP3 access derivative
processing.note: No original editing or mastering procedure is documented. Playback is unchanged. For comparison only, tools/compare.py rotates the guitar’s chroma features by five semitones upwards (--transpose-b -5); this changes neither the stream nor its time axis.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative of the Commons FLAC

composition.value: Public-domain underlying piano composition, as stated on Commons
composition.note: The page’s PD-because explanation concerns Satie’s death in 1925. It does not dedicate Laucke’s performance or arrangement to the public domain.

recording.note: Accepted under the recording-licence rule. The copyright-holder declaration explicitly releases this work under CC BY-SA 4.0; Commons records VRT permission ticket 2016052310032124. The API’s Public domain summary conflates the composition tag with the recording and is not used as the recording’s licence.
